statements.status_notes: Built from Debian expat 2.10.0-1 source on trixie, containing upstream UTF-16 validation fix 0cfd15bdf4b2c22d6b0df73610709dfb60921091 and regression tests 28fcfba540f6933aa8904a1514c4811713d2ab72. Runtime installed-library regression check is mandatory.

Built from Debian expat 2.10.0-1 source on trixie, containing upstream buffer-length validation fix 4d9b1c499ecb66323260a7274edcf86c5eab0517. The image build exercises the installed libexpat.so.1 and requires XML_ParseBuffer to reject oversized lengths before and after a valid parse chunk. Debian tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-77214.

Debian libx11 2:1.8.12-1 rebuilt with upstream patch 6d4432b13c0b3b6a644c13de9c793a14db48d545. Patch SHA256 dd9ecf20d2ca40c7ec3d8cdf3727c729f9fae3b6cc010e9436f152ae7cd6da31 is enforced before compilation; _XkbReadKeyActions rejects out-of-range action replies.

Debian libxrender 1:0.9.12-1 rebuilt with upstream patch 0564bce5446550c1b1681f3d8a933c20ea1455f7. Patch SHA256 565e816e88ca223cebc6f833cfcfa63d20aaa22c8293d878bdd059910c4a66fc is enforced before compilation; XRenderQueryFormats rejects numSubpixel greater than numScreens.

The runtime image installs Debian's security update libbrotli1 1.1.0-2+deb13u1 (trixie-security), whose quilt series applies the upstream decoder fix da980636 (Detect-and-report-invalid-stream-earlier.patch). The installed libbrotlidec.so carries the new _ERROR_FORMAT_BLOCK_SWITCH error code, i.e. the fix is present. Trivy still reports CVE-2026-111497 as affected with no fixed version because its vulnerability DB has not yet recorded the Debian fix for this freshly published CVE; this statement asserts the installed version is fixed. Remove once Trivy's Debian data lists the fixed version. Debian tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-111497.

expat DoS via improper memory tracking (CVE-2026-113351) is fixed upstream in the release line shipped as Debian sid source 2.10.0-1; trixie remains vulnerable (Debian marks it <no-dsa>, minor issue), so the native-security stage now builds expat from sid source 2.10.0-1 (up from 2.9.0-1) with the +cadverify1 local revision. The image build's installed-library regression checks still exercise libexpat.so.1. Debian tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-113351.

Arbitrary code execution via corrupted FTS5 virtual table. libsqlite3-0 ships only as a python:3.12-slim base dependency (the _sqlite3 stdlib module); the application uses PostgreSQL exclusively and never loads or queries the FTS5 module, so the vulnerable code path never executes. Debian tracks this as a minor issue with no DSA for trixie (fixed only in sid 3.54.1), so the statement is version-less: it applies to whatever unfixed trixie build the base carries. Revisit when a trixie-security fixed version is published. Debian tracker: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-119374.
